commands: set -eu; EXPECTED=1abd839b016efacf21b8fe7199260e23fc4ebf07; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo SOURCE_SHA=$ACTUAL; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

set -eu; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; test -x "$GRADLE"; "$GRADLE" :app:assembleDebug --stacktrace

set -eu; adb start-server >/dev/null; SERIALS=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | head -n1); MODEL=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; adb -s "$SERIAL" push "$APK" /data/local/tmp/aicallbridge-shell-probe.apk >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell chmod 644 /data/local/tmp/aicallbridge-shell-probe.apk; echo MODEL=$MODEL; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell id
